scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "cross-env PORT=4000 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
